MEMORANDUM

TO: Jim McCann

FROM: Sal J. Giacchi

REF: Inner City Sales Meeting Dec. 13 - 15, 1993

DATE: November 15, 1993

The Saddle Brook Marriott is the site selected for the above subject meeting, since the Glenpoint was totally booked.
The rate at the Saddle Brook is $85 per night and all meeting space rental of $200 per day was negotiated out of contract.
Our main contact at Hotel is Andrew Webber. He is Executive Meeting Manager, his phone number is (201) 843-9500 ext.#6823 the fax # at hotel is (210) 843-3539.

Attached is the preliminary agenda we discussed. The hotel will provide me with meeting room assignments by December 3rd. Please feel free to make any changes in reference to times of meals and meetings. However, by December 3rd it is recommended that firm times be in place, so hotel can provide necessary service to the group.

I expect to have contracts signed by Dec. 3rd at which time a copy will be provided to you. The contract will provide complete details of all functions, etc.
Once you have the list of attendee's, please forward a copy to me, so I can reserve rooms at hotel, and start negotiating air travel space.
If there is anything else you need for this meeting, please let me know as soon as possible.

cc: P.J. Marzullo
R.H. Orcutt

[SIGNATURE] S. J. G.

93182269
